# Leivant Construction Solutions

> Registered Tanzanian construction company (BRELA 626936) in Dar es Salaam. Plans, builds, renovates, supplies materials, rents equipment, and supervises construction across Tanzania.

## Sitemap

https://leivantconstruction.com/sitemap.xml

## Primary Website

https://leivantconstruction.com

## Business Summary

Leivant designs, builds, renovates, supplies materials, coordinates equipment, prepares project briefs, supports BOQ planning, connects clients with construction providers, and supervises construction projects across Tanzania.

## Featured Projects

- Kinyerezi Residential Development (Kinyerezi, Dar es Salaam — active site delivery)
- Zanzibar Coastal Build (Zanzibar — delivered with site supervision)
- Dodoma Structural Works (Dodoma — active slab, formwork and steel fixing)
- Mapacha wa 3 Complex (Dar es Salaam — delivered commercial complex)

## Main Services

- House construction
- BOQ preparation
- Equipment rental coordination
- Renovation contracting
- Materials supply
- Architecture and design
- Construction and delivery
- Engineering and technical review
- Site support
- Skilled labour coordination
- Construction supervision

## Service Area

Leivant serves Dar es Salaam (Kipawa, Kinyerezi), Zanzibar, Dodoma, and construction clients across Tanzania, including Tanzanian residents, developers, institutions, diaspora clients, and international clients planning projects in Tanzania.
